action_items: [OPTIONAL CONSISTENCY] /api/aurem-dev/codebase-health/fix returns HTTP 500 when a project_id is not owned by the caller, whereas /security-scan/fix returns 404 for the identical condition. Recommend raising HTTPException(status_code=404, detail={...}) inside routers/codebase_health.py request_fix() when cto_projects.find_one({project_id, user_id}) returns None, mirroring the security_scan.py path. critical_code_review_comments: services/finding_fix_applier.py — pipeline ordering is correct and safe: PAT fetch (never logged) → GitHub Contents API fetch → LLM patch → RE-RUN vanguard_scanner.scan_text → if same rule_id still fires, return ok=False BEFORE commit_files is ever called. The 'no dummy fix' invariant is enforced by construction. Verified by test_apply_finding_fix_rejects_unresolved_patch where commits list ends up [] after the rejection path.

routers/security_scan.py — apply_security_fix correctly: (a) calls current_dev() first (401 if no token), (b) validates project_id + finding.file (400), (c) looks up project scoped to {project_id, user_id} (404 if missing — no leak), (d) checks founder bypass via (is_admin or is_unlimited or tier=='founder'), (e) atomically deducts then refunds with $inc on any non-OK return from apply_finding_fix(), (f) maps internal error codes to HTTP status (422 patch_did_not_resolve, 401 credentials, 404 file_missing, 500 other).

rca_of_the_issue: Minor inconsistency only — /codebase-health/fix returns HTTP 500 instead of 404 when the caller is not the project owner. Reproduction: POST /api/aurem-dev/codebase-health/fix with a founder bearer and a fabricated project_id; expect 404 to match /security-scan/fix; observed 500 with the correct error body. Mitigation: in routers/codebase_health.py request_fix(), after the cto_projects.find_one({project_id, user_id}) returns None, raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail={'error':'project_not_found_or_not_yours'}) BEFORE the token deduction block (the existing tokens_refunded:true tail is unreachable in this branch because no deduction has occurred yet).
